Package index

Measurement: fit and interpret ratings

Follow how the functions connect. Keep the input and result objects at each step. The measurement route below is for ordinary RSM/PCM MML/JML; G-theory planning starts separately from observed scores. Other models use their documented output routes.

Step 1: Prepare rating data

Input: one row per rating. describe_mfrm_data() returns a design review; pass the rating data itself to fit_mfrm().

list_mfrmr_data() load_mfrmr_data()
List packaged ordered-response MFRM datasets
describe_mfrm_data() summary(<mfrm_data_description>) plot(<mfrm_data_description>)
Check rating data before fitting an MFRM

Step 2: Fit and inspect the model

Keep fit <- fit_mfrm(…). summary(fit) shows tables; it does not replace fit or compute the default diagnostics.

fit_mfrm() summary(<mfrm_cml_fit>) print(<mfrm_cml_fit>) print(<mfrm_comparison_fit>) summary(<mfrm_comparison_fit>)
Fit many-facet models to ordered ratings

Step 3: Diagnose and collect evidence

Keep diagnostics <- diagnose_mfrm(fit), then pass both fit and matching diagnostics to mfrm_results().

diagnose_mfrm() summary(<mfrm_diagnostics>) plot(<mfrm_diagnostics>)
Review response fit and the support for uncertainty summaries
mfrm_results()
Collect fitted estimates, diagnostics and reporting tables

Step 4: Report and save

Pass collected results to mfrm_report() or export_mfrm_results(). G/D-study and other supported result objects enter mfrm_report() directly.

summary(<mfrm_reporting_checklist>) mfrm_report()
Build reports from measurement, G-Study/D-Study, or residual results
export_mfrm_results()
Export an mfrm_results analysis archive

Extract estimates and uncertainty

Use these with fit when you need individual estimates, covariance, fitted responses or supported intervals. They complement the compact summary.

coef(<mfrm_fit>) coef(<mfrm_cml_fit>) coef(<mfrm_comparison_fit>) vcov(<mfrm_fit>) vcov(<mfrm_comparison_fit>) nobs(<mfrm_fit>) nobs(<mfrm_cml_fit>) nobs(<mfrm_comparison_fit>) logLik(<mfrm_fit>) logLik(<mfrm_comparison_fit>) AIC(<mfrm_fit>) BIC(<mfrm_fit>) AIC(<mfrm_cml_fit>) BIC(<mfrm_cml_fit>) fitted(<mfrm_fit>) residuals(<mfrm_fit>) predict(<mfrm_fit>) fitted(<mfrm_cml_fit>) fitted(<mfrm_comparison_fit>) residuals(<mfrm_cml_fit>) residuals(<mfrm_comparison_fit>) predict(<mfrm_cml_fit>) predict(<mfrm_comparison_fit>) as.data.frame(<mfrm_fit>) vcov(<mfrm_cml_fit>) logLik(<mfrm_cml_fit>) summary(<mfrm_jeffreys_fit>) print(<mfrm_jeffreys_fit>) coef(<mfrm_jeffreys_fit>) fitted(<mfrm_jeffreys_fit>) vcov(<mfrm_jeffreys_fit>) confint(<mfrm_jeffreys_fit>) logLik(<mfrm_jeffreys_fit>)
Extract coefficients, covariance, likelihood and observation counts
confint(<mfrm_fit>) confint(<mfrm_cml_fit>) confint(<mfrm_comparison_fit>)
Confidence intervals for native fit coefficients and GPCM slopes
